Compiler-based safety checker for GPU kernels. It lowers the real compiler's IR into a small kernel IR and decides specs in Lean 4 (bounds, hangs, exactly-once writes, barrier protocol, races) with no hand-written model. Specs and frontends plug in independently; today Triton/TLX and CuTe DSL on NVIDIA Blackwell.
